form: *I / you / we / they* + base verb: *I work.*
*he / she / it* + verb-*s*: *She works.*
Negative: *don't / doesn't* + base verb.
Question: *Do / Does* + subject + base verb?
use: Habits and routines.
Facts that are always true.
Timetables (*the train leaves at 7.45*).
rule.signals: *always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day*
rule.example: *She starts work at eight every day.*

form: *I / you / we / they* + darbības vārda pamatforma: *I work.*
*he / she / it* + darbības vārds ar *-s*: *She works.*
Noliegums: *don't / doesn't* + pamatforma.
Jautājums: *Do / Does* + teik. priekšmets + pamatforma?
use: Ieradumi un ikdienas rutīna.
Vienmēr patiesi fakti.
Saraksti un grafiki (*the train leaves at 7.45*).
rule_lv.signals: *always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day* (vienmēr, parasti, bieži, dažreiz, nekad, katru dienu)

form: *am / is / are* + verb-ing: *I am working.*
Negative: *am / is / are* + *not* + verb-ing.
Question: *Am / Is / Are* + subject + verb-ing?
use: Actions happening now.
Temporary situations.
Changes in progress.
Fixed plans for the future.
rule.signals: *now, at the moment, today, this week, these days, tomorrow* (for plans)
rule.example: *I'm meeting Anna at five tomorrow.*

form: *am / is / are* + darbības vārds ar *-ing*: *I am working.*
Noliegums: *am / is / are + not + -ing*.
Jautājums: *Am / Is / Are* + teik. priekšmets + *-ing*?
use: Darbība, kas notiek tieši tagad.
Pagaidu situācijas.
Mainīgas, norisošas situācijas.
Fiksēti nākotnes plāni.
rule_lv.signals: *now, at the moment, today, this week, these days, tomorrow* (plāniem)

form: Regular verbs: verb + *-ed* (*worked*).
Irregular verbs: learn them (*go - went, see - saw*).
Negative: *didn't* + base verb.
Question: *Did* + subject + base verb?
Past habits: *used to* + base verb.
use: Finished actions at a finished time.
A series of actions in a story.
Past habits and states (*used to*).
rule.signals: *yesterday, last week, in 2019, three days ago*
rule.example: *I went to the cinema yesterday.*

form: Regulārie darbības vārdi: pamatforma + *-ed* (*worked*).
Neregulārie darbības vārdi ir jāiemācās (*go - went, see - saw*).
Noliegums: *didn't* + pamatforma.
Jautājums: *Did* + teik. priekšmets + pamatforma?
Pagātnes ieradumi: *used to* + pamatforma.
use: Pabeigtas darbības pabeigtā laikā.
Darbību virkne stāstā.
Pagātnes ieradumi un stāvokļi (*used to*).
rule_lv.signals: *yesterday, last week, in 2019, three days ago* (vakar, pagājušajā nedēļā, 2019. gadā, pirms trim dienām)

form: *was / were* + verb-ing: *I was working.*
Negative: *wasn't / weren't* + verb-ing.
Question: *Was / Were* + subject + verb-ing?
Plan that did not happen: *was / were going to* + base verb.
use: An action in progress at a moment in the past.
A longer action interrupted by a short action (past simple).
Background in a story.
rule.signals: *at 8 o'clock yesterday, while, when, as*
rule.example: *I was cooking when the phone rang.*

form: *was / were + -ing*: *I was working.*
Noliegums: *wasn't / weren't + -ing*.
Jautājums: *Was / Were* + teik. priekšmets + *-ing*?
Plāns, kas nenotika: *was / were going to* + pamatforma.
use: Darbība, kas pagātnē noteiktā brīdī bija procesā.
Garāku darbību pārtrauc īsa darbība (Past Simple).
Stāsta fons.
rule_lv.signals: *at 8 o'clock yesterday, while, when, as*

form: *have / has* + past participle: *I have seen it.*
Negative: *haven't / hasn't* + past participle.
Question: *Have / Has* + subject + past participle?
use: Life experience (no exact time).
Something that started in the past and continues (*for / since*).
A past action with a result now.
Recent news (*just, already, yet*).
rule.signals: *ever, never, just, already, yet, for, since, so far, this week*
rule.example: *I have lived here for ten years.*

form: *have / has* + darbības vārda 3. forma (past participle): *I have seen it.*
Noliegums: *haven't / hasn't* + 3. forma.
Jautājums: *Have / Has* + teik. priekšmets + 3. forma?
use: Dzīves pieredze (bez precīza laika).
Kaut kas sācies pagātnē un turpinās (*for / since*).
Pagātnes darbība ar rezultātu tagad.
Jaunākās ziņas (*just, already, yet*).
rule_lv.signals: *ever, never, just, already, yet, for, since, so far, this week*

form: *have / has been* + verb-ing: *I have been working.*
Negative: *haven't / hasn't been* + verb-ing.
Question: *Have / Has* + subject + *been* + verb-ing?
use: An activity that started in the past and continues now.
A recent activity that explains a present situation.
How long something has been happening.
rule.signals: *for, since, all day, lately, recently, how long*
rule.example: *I've been studying English for two years.*

form: *have / has been + -ing*: *I have been working.*
Noliegums: *haven't / hasn't been + -ing*.
Jautājums: *Have / Has* + teik. priekšmets + *been + -ing*?
use: Darbība, kas sākās pagātnē un turpinās tagad.
Nesena darbība, kas izskaidro situāciju tagad.
Cik ilgi kaut kas notiek.
rule_lv.signals: *for, since, all day, lately, recently, how long*

form: *had* + past participle: *I had finished.*
Negative: *hadn't* + past participle.
Question: *Had* + subject + past participle?
use: The earlier of two past actions.
A reason for something in the past.
rule.signals: *before, after, by the time, already, when*
rule.example: *When we arrived, the film had already started.*

form: *had* + 3. forma: *I had finished.*
Noliegums: *hadn't* + 3. forma.
Jautājums: *Had* + teik. priekšmets + 3. forma?
use: Agrākā no divām pagātnes darbībām.
Pagātnes notikuma iemesls.
rule_lv.signals: *before, after, by the time, already, when*

skills.label: Future: will, going to, present continuous

form: *will* + base verb: *I will help you.*
*going to*: *am / is / are going to* + base verb.
Present continuous: *I'm meeting Anna at six.*
Present simple after *when / if / as soon as.*
use: *will*: quick decisions, offers, promises, predictions.
*going to*: plans and predictions with evidence.
Present continuous: fixed arrangements.
*be about to*: the very near future.
rule.signals: *tomorrow, next week, soon, when, as soon as, if*
rule.example: *Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.*

form: *will* + pamatforma: *I will help you.*
*going to*: *am / is / are going to* + pamatforma.
Present Continuous: *I'm meeting Anna at six.*
Pēc *when / if / as soon as* lieto Present Simple.
use: *will*: ātri lēmumi, piedāvājumi, solījumi, prognozes.
*going to*: plāni un prognozes ar pierādījumiem.
Present Continuous: fiksētas norunas.
*be about to*: pavisam tuvā nākotne.
rule_lv.signals: *tomorrow, next week, soon, when, as soon as, if*

form: *am / is / are* + past participle: *English is spoken here.*
Negative: *isn't / aren't* + past participle.
Question: *Is / Are* + subject + past participle?
use: When the action or the object is more important than who does it.
Processes, rules and notices.
rule.signals: *often, every day, usually, in my country*
rule.example: *These cars are built in Germany.*

form: *am / is / are* + 3. forma: *English is spoken here.*
Noliegums: *isn't / aren't* + 3. forma.
Jautājums: *Is / Are* + teik. priekšmets + 3. forma?
use: Kad svarīgāka ir darbība vai tās objekts, nevis darītājs.
Procesi, noteikumi un paziņojumi.
rule_lv.signals: *often, every day, usually, in my country*

form: *was / were* + past participle: *The book was written in 1990.*
Negative: *wasn't / weren't* + past participle.
Question: *Was / Were* + subject + past participle?
use: Past events when the doer is unknown or not important.
History, news reports.
*by* + doer when it is important.
rule.signals: *yesterday, last year, in 1889, when*
rule.example: *My bike was stolen last night.*

form: *was / were* + 3. forma: *The book was written in 1990.*
Noliegums: *wasn't / weren't* + 3. forma.
Jautājums: *Was / Were* + teik. priekšmets + 3. forma?
use: Pagātnes notikumi, kad darītājs nav zināms vai nav svarīgs.
Vēsture, ziņas.
*by* + darītājs, ja tas ir svarīgi.
rule_lv.signals: *yesterday, last year, in 1889, when*

form: *am / is / are being* + past participle: *The road is being repaired.*
use: An action in progress now, when the doer is not important.
rule.signals: *now, at the moment, right now*
rule.example: *Your order is being prepared.*

form: *am / is / are being* + 3. forma: *The road is being repaired.*
use: Darbība, kas notiek tagad, un darītājs nav svarīgs.
rule_lv.signals: *now, at the moment, right now*

form: *has / have been* + past participle: *The email has been sent.*
Question: *Has / Have* + subject + *been* + past participle?
use: Recent news or actions with a result now.
Actions up to now (*so far, already, yet*).
rule.signals: *already, yet, just, so far, recently*
rule.example: *The problem has been solved.*

form: *has / have been* + 3. forma: *The email has been sent.*
Jautājums: *Has / Have* + teik. priekšmets + *been* + 3. forma?
use: Jaunākās ziņas vai darbības ar rezultātu tagad.
Darbības līdz šim brīdim (*so far, already, yet*).
rule_lv.signals: *already, yet, just, so far, recently*

form: *will be* + past participle: *You will be told soon.*
Negative: *won't be* + past participle.
Question: *Will* + subject + *be* + past participle?
use: Future events when the doer is unknown or not important.
Announcements and notices.
rule.signals: *tomorrow, next week, soon, by Friday*
rule.example: *The results will be announced on Friday.*

form: *will be* + 3. forma: *You will be told soon.*
Noliegums: *won't be* + 3. forma.
Jautājums: *Will* + teik. priekšmets + *be* + 3. forma?
use: Nākotnes notikumi, kad darītājs nav zināms vai nav svarīgs.
Paziņojumi.
rule_lv.signals: *tomorrow, next week, soon, by Friday*

skills.label: Modal verbs: can, should, must, have to

form: *can / should / must* + base verb: *I can swim. You should rest. He must go.*
No *-s* with *he / she / it*: *he can, she should, it must.*
Negative: *can't* (*cannot*), *shouldn't*, *mustn't* + base verb. Question: *Can / Should / Must* + subject + base verb?
*have to* is a normal verb: *she has to go.* Negative and questions with *do / does*: *I don't have to go. Do you have to go?*
use: *can*: ability (*I can swim*) and permission (*Can I sit here?*).
*should*: advice (*You should see a doctor*).
*must*: a strong duty that comes from the speaker, or a written rule (*I must call my mum. Visitors must sign in*).
*have to*: a duty that comes from outside: work, school, the law (*I have to wear a uniform at work*). In speech, *have to* is more common.
*mustn't* = not allowed. *don't have to* = not necessary. *must* has no past or future: use *had to / will have to*.
rule.signals: *rule, law, allowed, necessary, advice, ability*
rule.example: *You must wear a seat belt, but you don't have to wear a hat.*

form: *can / should / must* + darbības vārda pamatforma: *I can swim.* *You should rest.* *He must go.*
Nav *-s* ar *he / she / it*: *he can, she should, it must*.
Noliegums: *can't* (*cannot*), *shouldn't, mustn't* + pamatforma. Jautājums: *Can / Should / Must* + teik. priekšmets + pamatforma?
*have to* ir *parasts* darbības vārds: *she has to go*. Noliegums un jautājums ar *do / does*: *I don't have to go.* *Do you have to go?*
use: *can*: spēja (*I can swim*) un atļauja (*Can I sit here*?).
*should*: padoms (*You should see a doctor*).
*must*: *stipra* pienākuma sajūta no paša runātāja vai rakstīts *noteikums* (*I must call my mum.* *Visitors must sign in*).
*have to*: pienākums no ārpuses: darbs, *skola, likums* (*I have to wear a uniform at work*). Runā biežāk lieto *have to*.
*mustn't = aizliegts*. *don't have to* = nav obligāti. *must* nav pagātnes *ne* nākotnes formas: lieto *had to / will have to*.
rule_lv.signals: *rule, law, allowed, necessary, advice, ability* (*noteikums, likums*, atļauts, nepieciešams, padoms, spēja)

form: *If* + present simple, present simple: *If you heat ice, it melts.*
You can use *when* or *whenever* instead of *if*: *Whenever it rains, the road gets slippery.*
Negative: *If you don't water plants, they die.*
use: Facts that are always true (science, nature).
General rules and habits.
Instructions: *If the light is red, stop.*
rule.signals: *if, when, whenever, every time*
rule.example: *If you leave biscuits on the desk, someone eats them.*

form: *If* + Present Simple, Present Simple: *If you heat ice, it melts.*
Var lietot arī *when* vai *whenever*: *Whenever it rains, the road gets slippery.*
Noliegums: *If you don't water plants, they die.*
use: Vienmēr patiesi fakti (zinātne, daba).
Vispārīgi noteikumi un ieradumi.
Norādījumi: *If the light is red, stop.*
rule_lv.signals: *if, when, whenever, every time*

form: *If* + present simple, *will* + base verb: *If it rains, we will stay home.*
The if-part can come second: *We will stay home if it rains.*
Other modals are possible in the result: *may, might, can, should.*
No *will* after *if*: *If it rains* (not *If it will rain*).
use: Real, possible situations in the future.
Promises, warnings and offers.
First conditional = one future situation. Zero conditional = always true.
rule.signals: *if, unless, as soon as, when, in case*
rule.example: *If you send the email now, she will reply before lunch.*

form: *If* + Present Simple, *will* + pamatforma: *If it rains, we will stay home.*
Nosacījuma palīgteikums (*if* daļa) var būt arī otrā vietā: *We will stay home if it rains.*
Rezultātā var lietot arī *may, might, can, should*.
Pēc *if* nelieto *will*: *If it rains* (nevis *If it will rain*).
use: Reālas, iespējamas nākotnes situācijas.
Solījumi, brīdinājumi un piedāvājumi.
First conditional = viena nākotnes situācija. Zero conditional = vienmēr patiesi.
rule_lv.signals: *if, unless, as soon as, when, in case*

form: *If* + past simple, *would* + base verb: *If I won the lottery, I would quit my job.*
Use *were* for every person in careful English: *If I were you, ...*
Question: *What would you do if ...?*
*Could* or *might* can replace *would.*
use: Unreal or unlikely situations in the present or future.
Advice: *If I were you, I'd talk to your manager.*
Imagining.
rule.signals: *if, imagine, suppose, if I were you*
rule.example: *If I were the boss, I would cancel Mondays.*

form: *If* + Past Simple, *would* + pamatforma: *If I won the lottery, I would quit my job.*
Rūpīgā valodā visām personām lieto *were*: *If I were you*, ...
Jautājums: *What would you do if* ...?
*Would* vietā var lietot *could* vai *might*.
use: Nereālas vai maz ticamas situācijas tagadnē vai nākotnē.
Padoms: *If I were you, I'd talk to your manager.*
Iztēle.
rule_lv.signals: *if, imagine, suppose, if I were you*

skills.label: Third conditional (if + had done, would have done)

form: *If* + past perfect, *would have* + past participle: *If I had known, I would have called.*
Negative: *If I hadn't ..., I wouldn't have ...*
*Could have* or *might have* if the result is less sure.
use: Unreal situations in the past: it did not happen.
Regret and criticism.
Imagining a different past.
rule.signals: *if, if only, too late, I wish* (past)
rule.example: *If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.*

form: *If* + Past Perfect, *would have* + 3. forma: *If I had known, I would have called.*
Noliegums: *If I hadn't ..., I wouldn't have* ...
*Could have* vai *might have*, ja rezultāts nav tik drošs.
use: Nereālas situācijas pagātnē: tas nenotika.
Nožēla un kritika.
Iztēle par citādu pagātni.
rule_lv.signals: *if, if only, too late, I wish* (pagātne)

form: Past condition, present result: *If* + past perfect, *would* + base verb: *If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.*
Present condition, past result: *If* + past simple, *would have* + past participle: *If I weren't so shy, I would have asked her.*
use: A past event that changes the present.
A present situation that would have changed a past event.
rule.signals: *now, still, today, by now, at the time*
rule.example: *If I had learned English earlier, I would speak it perfectly now.*

form: Inversion (formal): *Had I known, I would have helped.* = *If I had known.*
*Should you need help, call me.* = *If you should need help.*
*Were she here, she would agree.* = *If she were here.*
*unless* = *if ... not.* *as long as / provided that* = *only if.*
*wish* + past simple (now), *wish* + past perfect (regret), *wish* + *would* (annoyance).
use: Formal writing and speaking.
Strong regret and wishes.
Conditions with *unless, as long as, provided that, otherwise, but for.*
rule.signals: *had I, should you, were I, unless, provided that, as long as, otherwise, I wish, if only*
rule.example: *Had I known about the delay, I would have taken a taxi.*

form: *said / told* + (*that*) + clause: *She said (that) she was tired.*
Tenses usually go one step back: *am/is → was, work → worked, worked → had worked, will → would, can → could.*
Pronouns and time words change: *I → he/she, now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there.*
*tell* needs a person: *He told me.* *say* does not: *He said that ...*
use: Telling someone what another person said.
If the fact is still true, or you report it at once, the tense can stay: *She says she's tired.*
rule.signals: *said, told, now → then, yesterday → the day before*
rule.example: *"I'm working late," he said.* → *He said he was working late.*

form: *said / told* + (*that*) + teikums: *She said* (*that*) *she was tired*.
Laiks parasti iet vienu soli atpakaļ: *am/is → was, work → worked, worked → had worked, will → would, can → could*.
Mainās vietniekvārdi un laika vārdi: *I → he/she, now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there.*
*tell* vajag personu: *He told me.* *say* bez personas: *He said that* ...
use: Pastāstīt, ko cits cilvēks teica.
Ja fakts joprojām ir patiess vai pastāsti uzreiz, laiku var nemainīt: *She says she's tired.*
rule_lv.signals: *said, told, now → then, yesterday → the day before*

form: Yes/no questions: *asked* + *if / whether* + subject + verb: *She asked if I liked coffee.*
Wh-questions: *asked* + question word + subject + verb: *He asked where I lived.*
Normal word order, no *do / does / did*: *She asked what I did* (not *what did I do*).
Requests and orders: *told / asked* + person + (*not*) *to* + base verb: *He told me to wait.*
use: Reporting what someone asked.
Reporting what someone told or asked you to do.
rule.signals: *asked, wondered, wanted to know, told someone to*
rule.example: *"Where do you work?"* → *She asked me where I worked.*

form: Jā/nē jautājumi: *asked + if / whether* + teik. priekšmets + darbības vārds: *She asked if I liked coffee.*
Jautājumi ar jautājamo vārdu: *asked* + jautājamais vārds + teik. priekšmets + darbības vārds: *He asked where I lived.*
Parasta vārdu secība, bez *do / does / did*: *She asked what I did* (nevis *what did I do*).
Lūgumi un rīkojumi: *told / asked* + persona + (*not*) *to* + pamatforma: *He told me to wait.*
use: Pastāstīt, ko kāds jautāja.
Pastāstīt, ko kāds lika vai lūdza darīt.
rule_lv.signals: *asked, wondered, wanted to know, told someone to*

form: verb + *that*: *admit, claim, complain, explain, insist, promise, warn, announce.*
verb + person + *to* + base verb: *advise, warn, remind, invite, encourage, persuade.*
verb + *to* + base verb: *offer, refuse, promise, threaten, agree.*
verb + -ing: *suggest, admit, deny, recommend.*
verb + preposition + -ing: *apologise for, insist on, accuse (someone) of, congratulate (someone) on.*
use: Reporting what the person meant to do (promise, warn, deny), not only the words.
Shorter and more natural than *said that ...*
rule.signals: *admitted, denied, suggested, insisted, promised, warned, apologised for*
rule.example: *"I'm sorry I'm late."* → *He apologised for being late.*

skills.label: Indirect questions (Could you tell me where...)

form: Start with: *Could you tell me / Do you know / Can you tell me / I wonder.*
Then use statement word order: *... where the station is* (not *where is the station*).
No *do / does / did* in the second part: *... what time the shop opens.*
Yes/no questions: use *if* or *whether*: *Do you know if she is here?*
use: Polite requests for information.
Talking to strangers, customers and at work.
A full stop after *I wonder ...* / *I'd like to know ...*; a question mark after *Could you* / *Do you know ...*
rule.signals: *Could you tell me, Do you know, I wonder, I'd like to know, Would you mind telling me*
rule.example: *Could you tell me where the meeting room is?*

form: Sāc ar: *Could you tell me / Do you know / Can you tell me / I wonder.*
Tad lieto teikuma vārdu secību: ... *where the station is* (nevis *where is the station*).
Bez *do / does / did* palīgteikumā: ... *what time the shop opens*.
Jā/nē jautājumos lieto *if* vai *whether*: *Do you know if she is here?*
use: Pieklājīgi jautājumi pēc informācijas.
Sarunā ar svešiem cilvēkiem, klientiem un darbā.
Pēc *I wonder* ... / *I'd like to know* ... liek punktu; pēc *Could you / Do you know* ... jautājuma zīmi.
rule_lv.signals: *Could you tell me, Do you know, I wonder, I'd like to know, Would you mind telling me*

skills.label: Embedded questions (I wonder if..., what to do)

form: Question word + *to* + base verb: *I don't know what to do. I'm not sure how to start.*
*if / whether* (+ *or not*): *I can't decide whether to accept.*
An embedded question can be a subject: *What he said surprised me.*
After prepositions: *We talked about how to improve the results.*
use: Reports, emails and formal writing.
Uncertainty: *no idea, not sure, can't remember, unclear, it depends on.*
rule.signals: *I wonder, no idea, not sure, it depends on, the question is, whoever, whatever*
rule.example: *I have no idea how long the meeting will take.*

3.name: Apply
3.desc: Use the form in a sentence

5.name: Evaluate
5.desc: Judge and choose the best answer
